title: Programme 8 complexity and compression database
scope: Initial canonical census. A null value is deliberate and must carry a status and explanation; it is never imputed from a nearby construction.

conventions.coordinate_degree_vector: Exact ordinary total degrees of the displayed coordinate polynomials, in displayed coordinate order.
conventions.support_vector: Numbers of nonzero monomials in the fully expanded displayed coordinate polynomials, in displayed coordinate order. total is their sum.
conventions.coefficient_height: For a rational coefficient a/b in lowest terms with b>0, H(a/b)=max(abs(a),b); the construction height is the maximum over all expanded displayed coordinate coefficients.
conventions.boundary_prime_count: Number of non-affine height-one primes in the stated canonical finite-normalization boundary ledger. The locus and exclusions must be stated.
conventions.puncture_count: Number of deleted geometric points on the normalized one-dimensional root parameter in the stated ramified-boundary chart; it is not inferred from a unit rank unless the cited theorem identifies the points.
conventions.stable_moduli_dimension: Dimension of the image of the stated construction family in coarse stable polynomial left-right moduli, not the dimension of its raw parameter space.
conventions.rank_and_nilpotency_indices: Every rank and index names its operator. JH means the correction Jacobian for F=X+H; Hess(P) means the polynomial Hessian matrix. Sampled indices are diagnostics, not exact entries.
conventions.formal_verification_status: complete means the construction-level claims listed in scope are covered by a proof assistant; partial means only the stated subclaims are formalized; exact CAS or dependency-free checkers alone count as none.
